title: Team Staffing Specialist
description:
Are you a Practice Manager + Technician looking for the next step in your career? Would you like to stay within the veterinary industry but have the flexibility to work from home? Do you enjoy a fast-paced environment with the opportunity to make an impact on the rapidly expanding UrgentVet division of American Veterinary Group ?

If any of the above sounds like you, then you could be a great fit for our Team Staffing Specialist role! The Team Staffing Specialist is tasked with sourcing and interviewing practice manager and support staff talent, assessing technical skill level, and assembling inaugural teams for our newly constructed UrgentVet practices nationwide. This position requires strong project management skills and a sense of urgency for quickly-approaching deadlines.

Prior experience as a Veterinary Technician and Practice Management is required for this role . Due to the nature of this role, this position requires a high level of professionalism, communication, attention to detail, forward-thinking, and a strong command of the English language. Since this is a growing division, applicants with an open mind and ability to adapt to new situations are strongly encouraged.

This is a remote position reporting to the Director of Team Staffing. Therefore, time management skills and the ability to communicate effectively across departments in a remote setting is paramount. Occasional travel (5-10%) to events and team meetings may be required for this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify practice manager and support staff talent by sourcing resume databases, directories, practice websites, social media profiles, and testing extensive name generation techniques.

• Generate a pipeline of interested candidates via targeted email campaigns to both passive candidates and prior applicants.

• Conduct virtual screens with prospective candidates to understand technical skill level, position alignment, and scheduling availability.

• Contribute to the maintenance, accuracy, and growth of the candidate database/CRM (Lever).

• Provide market intelligence on market trends and research with Recruiting Team.

• Work with our Recruiting Team to continuously evolve our capabilities and identify opportunities to improve workflow efficiency, quality of work, and lead conversion rate.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• Minimum of 3 years of experience working as a veterinary technician.

• Applicants who are a Licensed/Registered/Credentialed Technicians (LVT/RVT/CVT) preferred!

• Ability to proactively manage deadlines and deliver results with quick turnaround times.

• Entrepreneurial mindset that is quick to take ownership of role and responsibilities.

• Experience working independently with little direction; able to work in ambiguous environments and comfortable with the unknown.

• Strong communication skills (especially written) with a focus on proper grammar and spelling.

• Ability to think ‘outside of the box’ and create staffing plans for hospitals in region.

• Ability to handle rejection in a highly competitive labor market.

• Ability to pivot focus and priorities based upon the ever-changing needs of our veterinary practices.

• Ability to travel on a limited basis (up to 10%).

Benefits

• Comprehensive healthcare: health, dental, & vision insurance

• Paid time off

• Paid Parental Leave + Paid Maternity Leave

• 401k plan options

• Generous veterinary care discounts

• Performance bonuses

title: ITAV Event Technical Producer
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s IT organization supports the mission of deploying artificial general intelligence (AGI) for the benefit of all. Our team is committed to providing seamless technological support and solutions to ensure that all OpenAI employees are well-equipped and connected. This enables them to contribute effectively towards our AI research, corporate operations and product initiatives.

About the Role

As an ITAV Event Technical Producer at OpenAI, you will lead technical production for complex internal and external events across multiple sites, from early planning through rehearsal and live delivery. You will partner with internal stakeholders and technical teams to translate event requirements into clear production plans. You will coordinate internal and external crews, direct large, distributed shows and coordinate cross-site handoffs, and use your technical expertise to resolve production challenges and make informed tradeoffs. You will also build reusable production practices and AI workflows, improve how teams deliver events, and mentor peers and junior crew members.

This is a full-time, onsite role requiring five days per week in San Francisco. Travel to other OpenAI locations is required as needed for assigned events.

In this role, you will:

- Lead technical production for complex internal, hybrid, and distributed events from early planning and scoping through rehearsal, live delivery, and debrief.

- Align Internal Comms, Marketing, Brand Experience, and Workplace on audience goals, requirements, scope, dependencies, and decision owners. Turn ambiguous or competing needs into an agreed production plan and readiness criteria.

- Configure and operate live audio, video switching, cameras, playback, conferencing, streaming, and recording systems for the agreed production.

- Integrate the run of show across sites and lead multiple crews globally for all-company events. Align technical cues, rehearsals, content handoffs, schedules, and contingencies with partner teams to deliver one cohesive event.

- Lead rehearsals and validate the complete audience experience, including remote contribution, playback, recording, and tested backup paths.

- Independently prioritize technical production tradeoffs and lead risk reviews and incident response. Resolve ambiguity within your scope, and seek guidance for complex situations or decisions owned by event, staffing, budget, or engineering partners.

- Build reusable production plans, show files, runbooks, and change-control practices. Coach peers and junior crew members to use them independently and verify improvements in readiness, troubleshooting, and execution.

- Set a prioritized roadmap for production improvements using audience feedback, debriefs, and recurring failures. Lead workflow changes across teams and define permanent-system improvements with AV Engineering.

- Identify repeatable production work and build AI and agentic workflows with partner teams. Validate results, establish operating and maintenance ownership, support adoption, and measure preparation effort or reliability improvements.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- Experience leading complex live or hybrid productions across multiple teams, from ambiguous requirements through rehearsal, delivery, and debrief.

- Advanced expertise in multiple live-production domains, such as audio, video, conferencing, streaming, or AV-over-IP, and the ability to diagnose complex interactions across the complete signal path.

- Experience configuring and operating professional production systems and creating reusable show files or control workflows.

- Practical AV-over-IP and networking knowledge sufficient to troubleshoot live media, timing, and connectivity with engineering partners.

- Experience independently resolving ambiguous production problems, setting detailed plans, and prioritizing tradeoffs while seeking guidance when complexity or decision authority requires it.

- Demonstrated owner

The Data and Orchestration team in London builds the platforms behind Wayve's data engineering, orchestration and inference workflows. Our infrastructure lets partner teams ingest, process and transform high-volume data from external vendors, vehicle fleets and customer programmes, and we make sure those systems are reliable, efficient and easy to use.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You'll help evolve Wayve's data pipeline platform. That means revamping our existing Harness system and building a new DAG-based orchestration system for our fleet's next-generation data volumes. You'll work on infrastructure used across the company, supporting high-priority data runs, batch inference, evaluations and business-critical incident response, and you'll work closely with partner teams to understand what they need from their pipelines.

🧩 What you'll be working on

- Designing, building and evolving scalable data pipeline and orchestration infrastructure for Wayve's next-generation autonomous driving data platform

- You work well with platform users and partner teams, turning their requirements into scalable technical solutions

Nice to have:

- Experience building shared libraries, developer tooling or internal platforms used across multiple teams

title: Vehicle Controls - Technical Lead
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a technical lead for controls, you will own the technical direction of our controls stack across its full lifecycle - from 0→1 development on new vehicle platforms to hardening, calibrating, and scaling controllers across production fleets. The systems you lead are high performance and safety-critical, operating under tight timing constraints on real machines in the field.

This role spans the full controls stack: low-level actuation and vehicle characterization on one end, and high-level trajectory tracking - both lateral and longitudinal. We work on a variety of different vehicle platforms: haul trucks, excavators, wheel loaders, dozers, and other heavy equipment across construction, mining, and agriculture.

In addition to your technical leadership, you will mentor and grow the existing controls team, set priorities across competing work streams, and set the standard for best practices. We move fast and we focus on excellence, for our products and for our business. If you are hands-on and looking for a place to have a multiplying effect on making autonomous systems a reality, Applied Intuition is the place for you!

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

- Set the technical direction for the controls stack across both 0→1 platform bring-up and production programs, and see designs through from prototype to deployed fleet

- Design and implement controllers at every level of the stack, from low-level actuator control to lateral and longitudinal trajectory tracking

- Design safe, redundant control systems that live within a safety-critical environment.

- Characterize the dynamics of customer vehicles across many embodiments - haul trucks, excavators, wheel loaders, dozers, and more - to create tailored controls solutions and close the gap between simulation and real-world behavior

- Build calibration and vehicle characterization workflows that scale controls performance from a single prototype to fleets of vehicles without per-vehicle hand-tuning

- Lead, mentor, and grow the existing controls team; set priorities, unblock engineers, and raise the technical bar through design reviews and hands-on collaboration

- Evaluate and apply academic research to create optimal-control-based solutions using techniques like nonlinear MPC and MPPI control

- Collaborate with customers' engineers in construction, mining, and agriculture, and manage those relationships through field deployments

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

- Passion for tackling challenging control problems involving a wide array of vehicles in varied and unstructured environments

- MSc or PhD in mech

У Райфі працює понад 5 тисяч співробітників, серед них одна із найбільших продуктових ІТ-команд, що налічує 900+ фахівців. • Знати і пропонувати клієнтам додаткові банківські продукти та послуги

Як виглядає робота в Райфі? Подивись відео з АІ-гідом, який пояснить усе просто і зрозуміло:
Твій досвід та навич ки: 

• Вільно володієш українською мовою

• Маєш навички роботи з комп’ютером

• Маєш додаткові засоби живлення та стабільний інтернет під час відключення світла

• Готовий допомагати клієнтам Райфу

• Швидко навчаєшся та легко сприймаєш великий обсяг інформації

• Легко знаходиш спільну мову з різними людьми

• Вмієш ефективно працювати в команді

• Можеш просто пояснювати складні речі

Пропонуємо те, що має значення саме для тебе: 

•
Конкурентна заробітна плата : гарантуємо стабільний дохід. Додатково, у нас діє реферальна програма винагороди за залучення нових колег до Райффайзен Банку.

•
Соціальний пакет: офіційне працевлаштування, 28 днів оплачуваної відпустки, додатковий «декрет» для татусів, та матеріальна допомога для батьків при народженні дітей.

•
Комфортні умови праці: віддалений формат роботи з можливістю працювати з будь-якого куточка України, забезпечення сучасною технікою.
(засоби живлення і стабільний інтернет забезпечуєш самостійно)
Перший місяць роботи пн-пт з 9:00 до 18:00
Далі 5\2 з плаваючими вихідними по 4\6\8 годин ( є нічні зміни)

•
Wellbeing програма: для всіх співробітників доступні медичне страхування з першого робочого дня; консультації психолога, нутриціолога чи юриста; дисконт програми на спорт та покупки; family days для дітей та дорослих; масаж в офісі.

Навчання та розвиток: повний супровід на старті (онбординг); тренерський центр для розвитку навичок; доступ до понад 130 навчальних онлайн-ресурсів; програма менторства; онлайн-бібліотека.

•
Крута команда: наші колеги - це спільнота, де вітаються допитливість, талант та інновації. Ми підтримуємо один одного, вчимося разом та зростаємо. Ти можеш знайти однодумців у понад 15-ти професійних ком’юніті, читацькому чи спортивному клубах.

•
Кар'єрні можливості: ми заохочуємо просування всередині банку між функціями.

•
Програма підтримки захисників і захисниць: ми зберігаємо робочі місця та виплачуємо середню заробітну плату мобілізованим. Для ветеранів та ветеранок у нас діє програма підтримки, розвивається ветеранська спільнота Банку. Ми працюємо над підвищенням обізнаності керівників та команд з питань повернення ветеранів до цивільного життя. Райффайзен Банк відзначений як один з найкращих роботодавців для ветеранів (Forbes).

Чому Райффайзен Банк?  Наша головна цінність - люди і ми даємо їм підтримку і визнання, навчаємо, залучаємо до змін. Приєднуйся до команди Райфу, адже для нас ТИ маєш значення! 

• Один із найбільших кредиторів економіки та аграрного бізнесу серед приватних банків 

• Визнаний найкращим працедавцем за версіями EY, Forbes, Robota.ua, Stud-Point, Delo.UA, NV, Odgers, UAFIC

• Найбільший донор гуманітарної допомоги серед банків (Червоний Хрест України, UNITED24, Superhumans, СМІЛИВІ) 

• Одна з найбільших ІТ-продуктових команд серед банків країни 

• Один із найбільших платників податків в Україні, за 2025 рік було нараховано 6 млрд гривень

Можливості для всіх:

• Райф керується принципами, що фокусуються на людині та її розвитку, у центрі уваги понад 5 тисяч співробітників та 2,5 мільйона клієнтів  

• Підтримуємо принципи різноманіття, рівності та інклюзивності.

title: Customer Growth Marketing Manager - EMEA

Zensai is the Human Success company. Our agentic AI platform coaches employees and managers through learning, performance, and engagement, natively inside Microsoft 365. More than 2,000 organizations use Zensai to make development part of how work happens, rather than a separate HR destination.
We believe the more AI we have, the more human we need to be. This role is where that belief meets our customers.
Why this role exists
Our biggest growth opportunity sits with the customers we already have. Over the next few years we plan to grow 3.6x from our existing customer base - and that growth depends on customers who stay, adopt more, and move up our editions.
You are Marketing's person in EMEA for that customer base. You know our customers in the region better than anyone in Marketing: who they are, what they're trying to achieve, where they're thriving, and where they're at risk. You turn that understanding into programs that keep customers engaged, grow accounts, and surface the stories that help us win more.
This is a marketing role that shows up with Sales. Under our go-to-market model, each region runs as a cross-functional pod - AEs, AMs, CSMs, solution and GTM engineers, and marketing - aligned around the customer. You're a member of the EMEA pod: in customer meetings, in sales meetings, and in the room when regional priorities are set. You know the region's objectives as well as the people carrying the number.
This is a generalist customer marketing role with a commercial number attached. You'll work hand in hand with Customer Success and Account Managers in the region, alongside our Lifecycle Marketing Manager and the central marketing team.
Where you sit
Solid line - Marketing - priorities, standards, brand and messaging, performance review, career development
Dotted line - VP Sales, EMEA - regional revenue priorities, target accounts, program focus
Closest partners - Customer Success Managers and Account Managers in EMEA · Lifecycle Marketing Manager · Product Marketing · Brand & Content · GTM Engineering
Counterpart - Customer Growth Marketing Manager, NA - one shared playbook, two regions
Regional pod - AEs, AMs, CSMs, SE/GTM Engineer, BDR, Channel in North America
Cadence you join - Weekly working session with the VP · weekly pipeline review and forecast call · weekly account and renewal review with CS and AMs · customer and sales meetings · monthly regional business review · quarterly planning with central marketing
Where regional and central priorities conflict, Marketing leadership and the RVP resolve it together. You flag early rather than absorb the trade-off.
What you own

• The regional customer strategy - the EMEA customer marketing plan, set with the RVP and regional commercial leadership.

• Expansion pipeline and ARR influenced by your programs in EMEA.

• Retention contribution - at-risk accounts reached and re-engaged before renewal.

• Customer stories - a steady supply of case studies, references, reviews, and speakers from the region.

• Program performance - what worked, what didn't, and what we do next, reported monthly.

What you'll do
Set the regional strategy

• Own the plan: set the EMEA customer marketing strategy in partnership with the VP, regional sales, and commercial leadership - which customers, which industries, which programs, and what each should deliver.

• Tie it to the number: build the plan from the region's revenue, renewal, and expansion objectives, and revisit it every quarter.

title: Senior Engineer II, Robotics Mechanical Design
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Our Platform Evaluation team tests and benchmarks alternative robotics platforms, including mobile manipulators, AMRs/AGVs, and other form factors, against our current production baseline. The team builds custom mobile manipulators by combining off-the-shelf components from different AMR and robot arm manufacturers, for example mounting one or more arms from a given vendor onto an AMR base from another.

As the Robotics Mechanical Design Engineer, you will own the mechanical design of these custom configurations end to end: mocking up multiple iterations (different arm brands, mounting positions, and configurations), modeling them fully in CAD, and preparing designs for simulation and physical build.

You will work closely with the Platform Evaluation engineers, who validate designs in simulation (NVIDIA Isaac Sim) and in physical testing once built. This is a hands-on mechanical and mechatronic design role, not a robotics software or controls position.

What You'll Be Building

• Design and iterate mounting and integration concepts combining robot arms with AMR/AGV base platforms

• Produce multiple design options per platform combination for evaluation

• Model custom mobile manipulator configurations in CAD, including brackets, structural supports, and interface hardware

• Run mass, center-of-gravity, and payload analysis to keep configurations within manufacturer specifications

• Design cable, hose, and connector routing between the arm, end effector, and AMR base

• Prepare simulation-ready CAD models and specifications (exportable URDF/mesh geometry) for Isaac Sim validation

• Document design decisions, tolerances, and assembly procedures, and support physical build and integration

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Mechanical or mechatronic design experience in a production, commercial, or applied R&D setting, ideally involving robotics or automated equipment

• Strong proficiency in 3D CAD software (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Onshape, or similar)

• Experience designing mechanical mounts, brackets, or structural interfaces for hardware integration

• Understanding of payload, mass properties, and center-of-gravity considerations for robotic arms on mobile bases

• Familiarity with robot arm and AMR specifications, including mounting interfaces, payload limits, and reach envelopes

• Comfortable iterating quickly, producing and revising multiple design options rather than one final design upfront

• Strong documentation habits, with the ability to communicate design intent and constraints to a non-mechanical audience

Bonus Points For

• Experience preparing CAD models for downstream simulation use, exporting clean geometry at a level of detail suited to URDF/mesh conversion

• Experience with robot arms and AMRs specifically, rather than general industrial equipment

• Familiarity with ROS2/URDF conventions

• Experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim or other robotics simulation tools

• Background in industrial design for warehouse automation, logistics robotics, or manufacturing equipment

• Experience with rapid prototyping methods such as 3D printing, sheet metal, and machining for early design iterations

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

Welcome to Frontline Managed Services ® - where innovation, technology, and efficiency converge to redefine the landscape of IT, Financial, and Administrative Managed Services for legal and professional service firms. As pioneers in the industry, we are driven by a relentless commitment to excellence.
Position Overview  

The Corporate Controller is responsible for leading the company's global accounting organization and ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of all financial reporting. This individual will oversee all accounting operations, internal controls, compliance, financial close, and external audits while building a scalable accounting infrastructure to support rapid organic growth, acquisitions, and international expansion.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting expertise with operational leadership, process improvement capabilities, and a continuous improvement mindset. This role will partner closely with FP&A, Operations, Sales, HR, Legal, IT, and executive leadership to provide financial insight and support strategic decision-making.
What You’ll Do
Financial Reporting & Accounting Operations

• Lead all global accounting functions including General Ledger, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Payroll Accounting, Fixed Assets, Revenue Accounting, and Treasury Accounting.

• Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close process while continually reducing close timelines.

• Ensure timely and accurate preparation of internal financial statements and management reports.

• Oversee consolidation of domestic and international entities.

• Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP and applicable international accounting standards.

• Maintain accounting policies and procedures across all business units.

Internal Controls & Compliance

• Design, implement, and continuously improve internal controls.

• Maintain strong governance over financial reporting processes.

• Coordinate annual financial statement audits and serve as primary liaison with external auditors.

• Manage relationships with tax advisors and support corporate tax compliance.

• Ensure compliance with federal, state, local, and international reporting requirements.

• Lead accounting policy research and implementation of new accounting standards.

Revenue Recognition

• Ensure proper application of ASC 606 across managed services contracts.

• Partner with Sales Operations and Legal on contract review.

• Develop standardized processes around revenue recognition for recurring revenue, implementation projects, and professional services.

• Monitor deferred revenue and contract asset/liability balances.

Process Improvement & Systems

• Drive automation of accounting processes through ERP and financial systems.

• Improve workflows through technology and AI-enabled solutions.

• Establish scalable processes supporting rapid company growth.

• Lead ERP enhancements and financial systems implementations.

• Improve reconciliation, reporting, and close efficiency.

Cash & Working Capital

• Oversee cash management and daily liquidity.

• Improve working capital metrics.

• Partner with AR leadership to reduce DSO.

• Monitor AP processes and vendor payment strategies.

• Optimize cash forecasting.

Strategic Business Partnership

• Partner closely with FP&A on forecasting and financial analysis.

• Support budgeting process through accounting insights.

• Participate in strategic initiatives including pricing, operational improvements, and profitability analysis.

• Support executive leadership with financial analysis and recommendations.

Mergers & Acquisitions

• Support financial due diligence.

• Lead accounting integration activities.

• Standardized acquired companies' accounting policies and reporting.

• Ensure timely integration into ERP and reporting systems.

• Assist with purchase accounting.

What You Bring
Education

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance

• CPA/CA required

• Master's degree preferred

title: Subject Matter Blog Specialist for Blockchain Applications
description:
This is a remote position.
Our Company is seeking to employ an innovative, qualified and experienced Subject Matter Specialist for Blockchain Applications.
Introduction
Blockchain is a system of recording information in a way that makes it difficult or impossible to change, hack, or cheat the system.
A blockchain is essentially a digital ledger of transactions that is duplicated and distributed across the entire network of computer systems on the blockchain. Each block in the chain contains several transactions, and every time a new transaction occurs on the blockchain, a record of that transaction is added to every participant’s ledger. The decentralized database managed by multiple participants is known as Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT).

title: Health Outcomes Liaison - East
description:
Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals , Inc. (Nasdaq ARWR) is a commercial stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.

Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.

Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI & San Diego, CA, and a state of the art manufacturing facility in Verona, WI. Our employees are nimble, science-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

The Position
The Health Outcomes Liaison (HOL) is a field-based scientific and clinical expert responsible for engaging regional and local payers and healthcare decision makers to communicate the clinical and economic value of Arrowhead’s cardiometabolic RNAi portfolio. The HOL will serve as a trusted scientific partner for managed care organizations, integrated delivery networks, pharmacy benefit managers, and other healthcare decision-makers by facilitating compliant, non-promotional scientific exchange related to clinical evidence, real-world evidence (RWE), health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), and value-based care. This role executes field-level engagement that supports the broader national payer strategy and reports to the Medical Affairs Payer Director (west coast player coach).
This is a highly mobile, customer-facing role that requires more than 60% travel across the assigned geography, including weeknights and weekends as business needs require. The successful candidate will thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment, operate with a high degree of agility and autonomy, and be comfortable working in a fast-paced biotechnology environment as organizational priorities shift and the portfolio advances.
Responsibilities
Field Payer Scientific Engagement

• Work with regional and local healthcare decision-makers focused on payer initiatives, RWE, HEOR, and removing clinical and economic barriers to patient access for Arrowhead’s cardiometabolic RNAi therapies.

• Plan and execute territory level engagement strategy for assigned customers, in alignment with direction set by the Medical Affairs Payer Director and broader Medical Affairs strategy.

• Establish and maintain scientific relationships with payer medical directors, pharmacy directors, formulary committee members, IDNs, ACOs, and other local/regional healthcare decision-makers.

• Deliver scientific presentations to formulary committees and other key healthcare decision-makers (HCDMs), communicating Arrowhead’s health economic model and supporting clinical data, and serve as the primary field-based point of contact for related questions.

• Maintain a consistent and productive field presence across the assigned geography to customer meetings, regional and national conferences as needed.

title: IT Support
description:
About Us

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in the service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, and more countries soon, love running on Tebi.

About the Role

You'll be the second pair of hands on IT support at Tebi, joining our team to keep a fast-growing, hybrid team equipped, unblocked, and moving. From the moment someone joins, the tools they use every day, you'll shape how it feels to work here. You'll take real ownership of your slice of the fleet, with the autonomy to make calls and the judgment to know when to loop others in.

What You'll Do

- Manage the IT onboarding seamlessly, hardware ready and configured before day one, for office and remote hires alike.

- Own IT off-boarding and recover hardware when someone leaves.

- Manage the devices, procurement, shipping, inventory, and repairs.

- Administer MDM, Jamf Pro enrolment and profile management for Mac and iPad.

- Handle systems,Google Workspace, provisioning, and access management.

- Be a first line of support, troubleshoot daily issues and escalate real security concerns.

What You'll Bring

- 3+ years of hands-on IT support or systems administration experience.

- Comfort owning a broad scope autonomously, without close supervision.

- Clear communication, equally at ease with a non-technical colleague or a vendor.

- Hands-on MDM experience, ideally with Jamf Pro.

- A solid grasp of identity and systems administration, including Google Workspace.

- Security awareness, you can spot phishing or access risks and know when to flag them.

Benefits

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Lunch Provided in Office

- Team building events

- Unlimited time off

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don't. It's a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it's a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How We Use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn't make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

Location: Mexico City (CDMX), Mexico
Team: Platform - Payments & FinOps (CDMX pod)
Level: TP3 (Product Manager) / TP4 (Senior Product Manager), depending on experience

 

About the Company

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators. 

 

About Payments & FinOps

Every transaction across our ecosystem moves money in more than one direction. A collector buys a card, a pack, or a break. A seller gets paid out. A refund or dispute gets resolved. Finance closes the books. The Payments & FinOps team builds the software behind all of it.

As our platforms and payment options grow, the team is moving from platform-specific payment flows to shared capabilities that every storefront and product can use. Payment options now include cards, digital wallets, PayPal, and loyalty currency like FanCash, alongside a growing international footprint. The goal is shared, reliable financial infrastructure so that each new product launch is faster, safer, and cheaper than the last.

The team is based in our Mexico City hub. It partners closely with Engineering, Finance and Accounting, Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and product teams across the U.S. and internationally.

 

The Role

We are seeking a Product Manager to own the Payments and FinOps product portfolio for Fanatics Collectibles. You will define the strategy and roadmap for how collectors pay, how sellers get paid, how money is returned when things go wrong, and how every transaction is accounted for.

You'll work with engineering, finance, and operations to build homegrown solutions or integrate vendors into our stack. You'll balance conversion, cost, risk, compliance, and operational efficiency. You'll be the product owner of the software and work hand in hand with the business owners of each financial operation to measure and improve its quality of service.

This is a high-impact role for a product manager who understands both the collector-facing and back-of-house sides of payments. It suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can balance long-term platform vision with rapid iteration.

title: Regional Director, Solutions Engineering, Enterprise
description:
ABOUT FACTORY

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

ABOUT THE ROLE

Factory is hiring a Solutions Engineering Manager to build the Enterprise Solutions Engineering team. Our Enterprise Solutions Engineers own the full customer lifecycle, pre-sales and post-sales: discovery, demos, proofs of concept, security and architecture reviews, pilot delivery, and the ongoing adoption and expansion of Factory once a customer is live. You will help build out the team, define how it runs, and own both the technical win and the production outcome for our fastest-growing Enterprise accounts.

You will hire and coach the people who do this work, set the standard for how it is done, and stay close enough to the accounts to do it yourself when it matters. You will work directly with Enterprise Sales leadership, and closely with Product and Engineering. This is a hands-on, zero-to-one leadership role at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering. It suits someone who combines real technical fluency, strong people leadership, and sound judgment under deal pressure.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

- Build the Enterprise Solutions Engineering team: define the hiring profile, recruit and close the founding Solutions Engineers, and grow the team with the Enterprise pipeline

- Design and iterate the team's operating playbook across the full lifecycle: discovery, pilot scoping, success metrics, security and compliance reviews, production rollout, and ongoing adoption and expansion

- Own the team's technical win rate, time-to-technical-win, pilot-to-production conversion, and post-sales adoption and expansion; report them to GTM leadership and use them to coach the team

- Partner with Sales leadership and Account Executives to run high-quality technical discovery, demos, and proofs of concept that tie directly to customer outcomes

- Carry accounts directly while the team ramps, and serve as the escalation point for complex evaluations, at-risk deployments, and high-stakes Enterprise deals, including CTO, VP Engineering, and Security stakeholders

- Onboard, coach, and develop Solutions Engineers; set clear expectations, career paths, and performance standards, and shorten ramp time with structured enablement

- Act as the voice of the field internally, feeding customer and prospect insight back to Product and Engineering

QUALIFICATIONS

You do not need to meet every requirement to be a strong candidate. If this role excites you and you have related experience, we encourage you to apply.

- 4+ years leading Enterprise Solutions Engineering, Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or customer engineering teams in enterprise software, spanning pre-sales and post-sales, including at least one team you built or scaled from a small starting point

- A strong hiring track record: you know how to source, assess, and close senior technical customer-facing talent

- A strong technical foundation and fluency in modern software development workflows, developer tooling, CI/CD, and AI coding tools

- Proven ability to partner with Sales while protecting technical integrity and customer trust

- Comfort in high-pressure, customer-facing environments; you can take over a stalled evaluation or a struggling deployment and move it forward

- Operational discipline

title: AI Inference Engineer
description:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.
We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.
We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.
As data centres become one of the largest and fastest-growing sources of electricity demand, Fuse is expanding into high-performance compute infrastructure at the intersection of energy and AI. We're building the GPU/CUDA performance layer and the inference serving layer at the same time, from scratch, and we're looking for the founding engineer to own the latter. Reporting directly to the CTO, you'll own the layer above kernels and hardware: how models actually get served, scaled and delivered against committed performance targets. Few companies can pair real power delivery with real compute the way Fuse can, which puts inference serving at the heart of our offering.
Responsibilities

• Define Fuse's inference serving strategy and architecture from first principles

• Design and build the serving stack: request routing, batching, scheduling and autoscaling for high-throughput, latency-sensitive inference workloads

• Own model-level optimisation strategy for serving, deciding where and how to apply quantisation, distillation, speculative decoding and similar techniques to improve throughput and cost per token, partnering with the CUDA/GPU engineers

• Make the core software architecture calls on serving frameworks and orchestration (e.g. vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, Triton Inference Server or equivalents)

• Translate throughput, latency and uptime commitments into concrete technical specifications and serving capacity plans

• Act as direct technical owner of inference performance and reliability

• Work closely with the CUDA and GPU engineering teams to integrate custom kernels and hardware performance work cleanly into the serving layer

• Set the standards, tooling and benchmarks this function will run on as it grows

Requirements

• 4+ years building or operating large-scale inference serving systems, or equivalent strong project/industry experience

• Deep, hands-on experience with inference serving frameworks and the techniques used to optimise them (batching, KV-cache management, quantisation, speculative decoding)

• Strong systems thinking, able to reason about the full path from incoming request to served response across a large cluster

• Comfortable working directly with GPU/CUDA engineers to integrate low-level performance work into a serving system

• A track record of making high-stakes architecture calls and owning the outcome

• Comfort operating without a playbook: this is a founding role shaping a new function, not joining an established one

• Bonus: Triton or custom ML inference/training frameworks; autoscaling or capacity planning for large-scale inference; multi-tenant serving or SLA-driven infrastructure; background at a hyperscaler, frontier AI lab or large-scale distributed inference system; Kubernetes/Slurm; interest in energy markets, grid systems or sustainability-focused compute

Benefits

• Competitive salary and eligibility for equity

• Biannual bonus scheme

• Fully expensed tech to match your needs

• Private health insurance

• Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

As we hire globally, benefits vary by location.

The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. title: Configuration Management Specialist - Hardware
description:
Location: Remote (U.S.)
Job Type: Full-Time/Temporary - 12+ months
Industry: Aerospace & Defense
Comp. Range is: $95K to $106K

Position Summary
We are seeking detail-oriented Configuration Management (CM) Support Specialists to support aerospace engineering and product lifecycle management activities. The successful candidate will be responsible for controlling engineering documentation, supporting change management processes, coordinating release activities, and ensuring configuration integrity across programs and products.

Key Responsibilities

•
Change analyst and technical reviews of engineering and documentation changes, such as Windchill change requests, change notices, evaluations, problem reports (redlines), variances and deferrals

•
Requirements and system engineering artifact management: reviews in Jama, plus exporting and reformatting Jama documents

•
Work orders: Jules tWO (work order template) reviews

•
Rover: change notice reviews (new process being rolled out)

•
Queue triage: completeness checks on incoming change packages before analyst review

•
Tool rollout support: user testing, user support and data cleanup for new CM tools such as Change Orchestrator and Rover

•
Process documentation: drafting updates to work instructions and wiki pages, for Blue Origin approval

•
Configuration status accounting: baseline reports, change status and aging reports, and metrics

•
Data quality: audits of part and document attributes, numbering, metadata and part-to-document links

•
Document management: librarian work such as number assignment and release verification, and NASA deliverables (DRDs)

•
CM audit support: evidence collection and audit preparation

Required Qualifications

• Associate’s degree in related field and 5 years related experience; or, bachelor’s degree in engineering, Technical Management, Business Administration, or related discipline and 3 years related experience; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of degree.

• Experience supporting Configuration Management, Engineering Data Management, Document Control, or Product Lifecycle Management environments.

• Hands-on experience with Windchill PLM or comparable Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) platforms.

• Experience releasing engineering drawings, documentation, and work orders.

• Understanding of engineering change management processes including:

• Change Requests (CRs)

• Change Notices (CNs)

• Variances/Deviations

• Engineering Change Orders (ECOs)

• Experience with Model-Based Definition (MBD) methodologies.

• Proficiency using Creo View .

• Working knowledge of ASME drawing and drafting standards .

Preferred Qualifications

• Aerospace or defense industry experience.

• Experience supporting military, commercial aerospace, space, or advanced technology programs.

• Experience collaborating directly with engineering managers, design engineers, manufacturing engineers, and program leadership.

Apply today if you have a passion for configuration management, engineering data integrity, and supporting world-class aerospace programs.

MORI Associates is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive workplace where all employees are valued and respected. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

ABOUT REBAR

Rebar is building the AI operating system for commercial HVAC, Electrical, and Plumbing.

Over the past year, our quoting platform has processed tens of thousands of projects across North America, and we’ve doubled our revenue in the first 6 weeks of this year. Our customers include many of the top firms in the industry. Some of these companies are running billion-dollar construction projects on workflows that still look like it’s 1985.

Construction is 10% of GDP and still massively underserved by software. We are changing that.

We recently raised a $14M Series A from leading construction tech investors and are entering our next phase of growth. We are building a set of AI native products that will define how this industry operates.

We are looking for a Manager of Technical Support who wants to build a support team clients rave about. Our clients already tell each other that Rebar support is one of the best reasons to work with us, and your job is to scale that as we grow. You will lead and expand our technical support team, extend coverage to serve customers in every US time zone, and build the processes, tooling, and metrics that keep us fast and human at higher volume. You will partner with Product and Engineering to turn support insights into product improvements, making sure what clients experience shapes how we bring AI to construction.

We aren't a call center. We respond fast, we're human, and we go the extra mile for every client. The foundation is solid, and our customer base is growing quickly. We need a leader to scale the team and its processes without losing what makes our support special.

Reporting directly to the Head of Client Success, you'll lead and grow our team of two remote Technical Support Specialists into a team that covers the whole country. Today we cover 7 a.m.-8 p.m. ET. With clients across the US, including Alaska and Hawaii, we need to extend coverage through 7 p.m. PT (10 p.m. ET). We're looking to you to build the team, structure, and technical depth to make that happen.

- Design coverage models: create staffing plans, schedules, and shift structures that keep response times fast across every US time zone.

- Lead and coach: run 1:1s, give regular feedback, and set clear expectations so each specialist grows their technical skills and their career.

- Own support performance: set, track, and report on SLAs and KPIs (first response time, resolution time, CSAT, backlog, and escalation rate), and hold the team to a high standard.

- Protect the client experience: keep support personal, proactive, and human as volume grows. Speed matters, and so does going the extra mile.

- Shape AI-assisted support: decide how Intercom Fin and AI workflows handle routine questions so your team can focus on the problems that need a person.

- Build processes and structure: create and refine the workflows, escalation paths, triage rules, macros, and playbooks that let the team scale.

- Own our support tooling: manage and improve our Intercom setup (inbox routing, automations, help center and reporting) and its integrations with HubSpot, Linear and other internal tools.

- Develop technical expertise: build training programs so the team knows our product, construction and MEP (mechanical, electrical and plumbing) workflows, and troubleshooting inside out.

- Partner with Engineering and Product: bring bugs, trends and product gaps to the right people with clear, prioritized, data-backed feedback, and push complex issues through to resolution.

- Collaborate with Client Success and Implementation: keep handoffs smooth across the client journey, and share insights on account health, adoption risk and upsell signals.
